entries: It make all bad. Manshroom take home. Human help Scaphin, Scaphin help human.
它把一切变坏。人菇夺走家。人类帮斯卡芬，斯卡芬帮人类。
It would be wise to listen, @. Caution, as always, eludes you.
听听劝才是明智的，@。谨慎这东西，你从来就学不会。
As usual, we shall assist, especially since we need that key.
和往常一样，我们会帮忙——尤其因为我们需要那把钥匙。
Be mindful of your words, @, lest they put us in danger.
说话小心点，@，免得把我们置于险境。
We are searching for answers to this plague that is taking our memories, and looking for a key.
我们在寻找这场夺走我们记忆的灾疫的答案，也在找一把钥匙。
Some Scaphin good. Some bad. You humans not like others. Why you leave home?
有些斯卡芬好。有些坏。你们人类和别的不一样。为什么离开家？
And what would that make you?
No move! Why humans in Scaphin home?
不许动！人类为什么在斯卡芬家里？
The guards allowed us to pass.
Scaphin have other problem. Evil juice make Scaphin bad. Evil juice make Manshroom.
斯卡芬还有别的麻烦。邪恶的汁水让斯卡芬变坏。邪恶的汁水造出人菇。
Talk to son. He need danger to prove worth. Maybe take as distraction. Or mule. Not care.
跟儿子谈。他需要危险来证明价值。也许带上当个幌子。或者驮兽。随便。
At service. More than mule. At least... two mule.
听候差遣。比驮兽强。至少……顶两头驮兽。
If no want help, then will wait. Father give no other task...
如果不要帮手，那就等着。父亲没给别的任务……
喜欢胆大的那个。敢说实话。
Killing monsters is reward enough for me.
对我来说，杀怪物本身就是奖赏。
Reward? A key? I suppose we do need it.
奖赏？一把钥匙？我们确实需要它。
Kill Manshroom. Return Scaphin home. King reward with find shiny thing.
杀掉人菇。帮斯卡芬夺回家园。国王的奖赏，是帮你找亮闪闪的东西。
What would you have us do? And what could you do for us?
你要我们做什么？你又能为我们做什么？
This is your speciality, no? We do not fear such creatures.
这是你的专长，不是吗？我们不怕这种生物。
Good. Return way you came. Before reach bridge, find tunnel. Not spider tunnel.
好。沿来的路回去。到桥之前，找隧道。不是蜘蛛的隧道。
Manshroom? I do not like the sound of this.
He called you little. I suppose there's a first time for everything.
他叫你「小小」。凡事总有第一次嘛。
Expected. Humans much talk but no think.
意料之中。人类话多，脑子少。
We shall aid you, great Scaphin King, and claim that key.
我们会相助，伟大的斯卡芬国王，并取得那把钥匙。
We have heard of this... "juice", left by the dark lord. It lies beneath this place and corrupts all things.
我们听说过这种……「汁水」，是黑暗领主留下的。它在这地方之下，腐蚀万物。
Bad Scaphin? We are new to your kind.
坏斯卡芬？我们对你们这一族还很陌生。
